If someone tries to save the shift by dosing a [[silicone|silicone]] defoamer by eye into a clear gel, the foam does collapse—but so do product clarity and lather during use. [[foam|Пена]] — термодинамически неустой: A [[foam|foam]] is a thermodynamically unstable dispersion of gas in a liquid in which bubbles are separated by thin liquid films (lamellae) meeting at Plateau borders [@rosen2012; @tadros2013]. 2. **Газовая диффузия (диспропорциониров: 2. **Gas diffusion (disproportionation / Ostwald ripening):** according to the [[laplace|Laplace pressure]] equation $\Delta p = 2\gamma/r$, pressure is higher inside smaller bubbles, so gas diffuses from small cells into larger ones and the foam coarsens.

When a local region of a lamella stretches, the concentration of [[adsorption|adsorbed]] [[surfactant|surfactant]] molecules drops there, [[surface-tension|surface tension]] $\gamma$ rises locally, and adjacent liquid is pulled back into the thinned spot, "self-healing" the film.

The thermodynamic driving force for a droplet to enter the liquid–air interface and spread across it is defined by the entry coefficient $E$ and spreading coefficient $S$ [@rosen2012; @tadros2013]:
где $\\gamma_{LD}$ — межфазное натяжение: where $\gamma_{LD}$ is the interfacial tension between the surfactant solution and the defoamer droplet. When both conditions are satisfied, the droplet breaches the adsorption layer, draws liquid out of the film, and forms a hydrophobic bridge, rupturing the bubble instantaneously.

A [[fractional|fractional factorial design]] cuts the run count by two or four, but demands care: without reading the aliasing structure, a strong [[interaction|interaction]] between emulsifier and fatty alcohol can be mistaken for the effect of homogenization. Дробный план $2^{k-p}$ берёт сбалансиров: A $2^{k-p}$ fractional design takes a balanced $1/2^p$ fraction of the full $2^k$ design by defining $p$ columns as products of the remaining ones (**generators**) [@montgomery2017; @nist-handbook]. In the simplest $2^{3-1}$ half-fraction (4 runs instead of 8), we set $C = AB$ in $-1/+1$ coding. Multiplying both sides by $C$ (where $C^2 = I$) gives the **defining relation**:
Умножая каждый фактор на $I$, получаем п: Multiplying each factor by $I$ yields the **aliasing** pairs: $A = BC$, $B = AC$, $C = AB$. In this matrix, the contrast computed for column $C$ estimates not the pure [[main-effect|main effect]] $C$, but the sum $C + AB$.
Степень чистоты оценок задаёт **разрешен: How cleanly effects are separated is given by the **design resolution** (the length of the shortest "word" in the defining relation) [@montgomery2017]:
- **Разрешение III** ($I = ABC$): главны: - **Resolution III** ($I = ABC$): main effects are not aliased with one another, but they are aliased with two-factor interactions. Suitable only for initial screening when interactions are sparse or when followed by a fold-over augmentation.
- **Разрешение IV** ($I = ABCD$, наприме: - **Resolution IV** ($I = ABCD$, e.g., $2^{4-1}$ in 8 runs): main effects are free of two-factor interactions (aliased only with three-factor ones, $A = BCD$), while two-factor interactions are aliased with each other in pairs ($AB = CD$).
- **Разрешение V** ($I = ABCDE$, наприме: - **Resolution V** ($I = ABCDE$, e.g., $2^{5-1}$ in 16 runs): both main effects and all two-factor interactions are unaliased with each other.

Турбина Раштона потребует почти вчетверо: The Rushton turbine will require nearly four times more power, channeling it into local shear and dissipation
Поскольку P = Np·ρ·N³·D⁵, при равных D и: Since P = Np·ρ·N³·D⁵, at equal D and N the power is directly proportional to the power number Np, and the radial discharge intensifies local shear.
Наклонно-лопастная мешалка потребит боль: The pitched-blade impeller will consume more power due to axial pumping

Мощность на валу зависит от геометрии ра: Shaft power depends on impeller geometry via Np, diameter to the fifth power, and speed cubed—not directly on vessel volume.
Для чего в аппарате с маловязкой водной: Why are vertical baffles installed in a vessel containing a low-viscosity aqueous phase and a high-speed impeller?
Чтобы усилить центральную воронку и быст: To deepen the central vortex and draw air into the solution faster
Затягивание воздуха через воронку вызыва: Drawing air down a vortex causes foaming and complicates subsequent deaeration—baffles are installed specifically to prevent this.
Чтобы погасить круговое вращение массы к: To break solid-body swirling rotation, suppress the vortex, and establish vertical top-to-bottom circulation
Перегородки шириной около T/12–T/10 прео: Baffles roughly T/12–T/10 wide convert tangential swirl into an axial turnover loop between the bottom and the surface.
Чтобы заменить скребки при охлаждении гу: To replace scrapers when cooling a thick cream in the laminar regime
В высоковязких средах перегородки не нуж: In high-viscosity media, baffles are counterproductive: dead zones form behind them, and the wall layer must instead be renewed by an anchor or helical-ribbon impeller.

If a small [[turbine|turbine impeller]] ($D/T = 0{,}25$) is left running without baffles, the aqueous stage forms a deep vortex that pulls in air and foam, while during the cream stage the bulk moves only within a narrow [[cavern|cavern]] around the shaft. Understanding vessel geometry and impeller types lets you match the circulation loop to each processing stage up front and avoid motor overload or vertical stratification.

Гидродинамику аппарата задают два безраз: Agitated-vessel hydrodynamics are governed by two dimensionless impeller numbers—the **flow (pumping) number** $N_Q$ and the [[power-number|power number]] $N_p$ [@him2003]:
Здесь $Q_p$ — объёмный расход циркуляции: Here $Q_p$ is the impeller volumetric pumping rate (m³/s), $N$ is the rotational speed (s⁻¹), $D$ is the impeller diameter (m), and $\rho$ is the fluid density (kg/m³). In the [[laminar|laminar regime]] ($Re = \rho N D^2 / \mu < 10$), the power number is inversely proportional to the [[reynolds-mix|impeller Reynolds number]]: $N_p = K_p / Re$, giving $P = K_p\,\mu\,N^2\,D^3$. For [[shear-thinning|shear-thinning]] creams, the [[apparent-viscosity|apparent viscosity]] is evaluated at the effective shear rate via the Metzner–Otto relation [@metzner1957]:
Геометрию аппарата описывают через безра: Vessel geometry is expressed as dimensionless ratios to the inside tank diameter $T$: relative impeller diameter $D/T$, bottom clearance $C/T$, and relative liquid height $H/T$ [@him2003]. Axial impellers (hydrofoils, pitched-blade turbines) maximize circulation $Q_p$ per watt of power—ideal for bulk blending and powder suspension. Radial impellers (Rushton disc turbines) discharge radially toward the wall and put more energy into local shear. In high-viscosity fluids with a [[yield-stress|yield stress]], small impellers lose volume coverage, so close-clearance agitators are used—such as an [[anchor|anchor]] with [[scraper|scrapers]] or a helical-ribbon impeller ($D/T = 0{,}90\text{–}0{,}98$) [@him2003; @chhabra2008].

Равномерный цвет влажных образцов не гов: Uniform color in wet samples says nothing about liquid penetration into an agglomerate and does not diagnose a dry core.
Медленное оседание плотного влажного оса: Slow settling of a dense wet sediment after 24 hours at rest
Седиментация полностью смоченных частиц: Sedimentation of fully wetted particles relates to suspension stability, not initial air displacement from the surface.
Почему предварительное растирание ксанта: Why does pre-slurrying xanthan gum with glycerin (1:4) prevent lumping when subsequently added to water?
Глицерин химически деполимеризует ксанта: Glycerin chemically depolymerizes xanthan and lowers its molecular weight
Полисахарид не разрушается в глицерине;: The polysaccharide does not degrade in glycerin; once in water, its macromolecules hydrate and deliver the target viscosity.
Глицерин смачивает и физически разделяет: Glycerin wets and physically separates the particles without swelling them immediately, allowing water to reach every granule uniformly
В неводном смачивателе оболочка не образ: In a non-aqueous wetting carrier, the surface does not form a viscous gel instantly, so particles enter the water already spatially separated.
Глицерин повышает поверхностное натяжени: Glycerin raises water surface tension above 90 mN/m and speeds up imbibition
Глицерин, напротив, немного снижает пове: On the contrary, glycerin slightly lowers the surface tension of water (about 63 mN/m at 20 °C), and its primary benefit is preventing premature swelling.
После диспергирования оксида цинка в мас: After dispersing zinc oxide in oil, the sample passed through a 100 µm sieve with zero residue. What does this prove?
Все первичные частицы имеют размер меньш: All primary particles are smaller than 1 µm and the pigment is ready for filling
Отсутствие остатка на сите 100 мкм исклю: Zero residue on a 100 µm sieve rules out only the largest lumps, but cannot distinguish 20 µm aggregates from submicron particles.
В пробе нет комков крупнее выбранного от: The sample contains no lumps larger than the chosen sieve mesh, though smaller agglomerates may still be present
Ситовой анализ отсекает лишь грубую фрак: Sieve analysis cuts off only the coarse fraction at the mesh aperture; a Hegman grindometer or microscopy is needed to assess fine dispersion.
Порошок полностью растворился в масле на: The powder has completely dissolved in the oil at the molecular level
Неорганические оксиды в маслах нераствор: Inorganic oxides are insoluble in oils; passing through a sieve characterizes suspended particle size, not dissolution.
Оператор высыпает [[xanthan|ксантановую: An operator dumps [[xanthan|xanthan gum]] or [[carbomer|carbomer]] all at once into the vortex of a running reactor. A minute later, whitish rubbery lumps — "fish-eyes" — float on the water surface. Thirty minutes of mixing barely changes anything: gel viscosity falls short of target, and a slimy clot stays behind on the discharge strainer. Slicing a lump open with a scalpel reveals completely dry powder beneath a translucent gel crust. A similar defect occurs when adding titanium dioxide or zinc oxide to an oil phase: without air displacement and sufficient shear, the powder remains as hard grits that feel grainy on the skin.
![Краевой угол смачивания и образование: ![Wetting contact angle and "fish-eye" formation in a polymer](media:powder-wetting-contact.svg "When a hydrophilic polymer is dumped directly into water, the outer shell swells and seals off a dry core; pre-wetting in a glycol separates the particles and accelerates hydration.")
Перевод порошка в однородную систему все: Turning a powder into a uniform dispersion always proceeds through three distinct stages: [[wetting|wetting]], deagglomeration, and subsequent [[dissolution|dissolution]] (for water-soluble polymers) or [[suspension|suspension]] stabilization (for insoluble pigments and UV filters) [@hiemenz1997; @coulson1999].
На первой стадии жидкость должна вытесни: In the first stage, the liquid must displace air from the pores between particles. Equilibrium at the solid–liquid–vapor interface is set by Young's equation for the [[contact-angle|contact angle]] $\theta$ and liquid [[surface-tension|surface tension]] $\gamma_{LV}$ [@hiemenz1997]:
Самопроизвольное втягивание жидкости в к: Spontaneous liquid imbibition into powder capillaries occurs only when $\theta < 90^\circ$ ($\cos\theta > 0$). The rate of capillary penetration is described by the Washburn equation [@hiemenz1997]:
где $l$ — глубина проникновения жидкости: where $l$ is liquid penetration depth (m), $r$ is effective pore radius (m), $\eta$ is liquid viscosity (Pa·s), and $t$ is time (s). As soon as the outer [[hydrocolloid|hydrocolloid]] particles contact water and begin to swell, viscosity $\eta$ at the capillary mouths jumps by three to four orders of magnitude. Imbibition virtually halts, leaving the interior of the lump dry.
На второй стадии нужно разрушить рыхлые: In the second stage, loose particle clusters must be broken apart by mechanical shear in a [[rotor-stator|rotor-stator homogenizer]] or high-shear sawtooth mixer [@him2003]. A standard anchor agitator imparts low shear and merely tumbles intact lumps around the tank. In the third stage, polymers undergo [[mass-transfer|mass transfer]] — hydration and chain uncoiling — whereas pigments require [[steric|steric stabilization]] by a dispersant to prevent re-[[flocculation|flocculation]].

Почему центробежный насос теряет подачу: Why does a centrifugal pump lose flow capacity and break down the structure of a thick cream?
Как проверить риск кавитации при выгрузк: How do you check cavitation risk when discharging hot product or operating under vacuum?
Почему объёмный насос нельзя регулироват: Why must a positive-displacement pump never be throttled with a discharge valve?
Как изменится рабочий расход центробежно: How will the operating flow rate of a centrifugal pump with a drooping head curve change if system hydraulic resistance increases (for example, a filter partially clogs)?
Рабочий расход останется равным паспортн: The operating flow rate will stay at the nameplate maximum
Паспортный максимум расхода достигается: Nameplate maximum flow is achieved only at minimal head, not under arbitrary system resistance.
Точка пересечения кривых сместится влево: The intersection point will shift to the left, and the operating flow rate will decrease
Подъём кривой сети сдвигает пересечение: A steeper system curve shifts the intersection with the drooping pump curve to higher head and lower flow rate.
Расход вырастет пропорционально росту пе: Flow rate will rise proportionally to the pressure drop increase across the filter
Дополнительное сопротивление отбирает ча: Added resistance consumes part of the pump's available head and slows flow rather than accelerating it.
Нужно перекачать 800 кг крема на ламелля: You need to transfer 800 kg of a lamellar-gel-network cream (low-shear viscosity 18 Pa·s) to filling without losing consistency. Which pump is best suited?
Санитарный объёмный насос (кулачковый ил: A sanitary positive-displacement pump (rotary lobe or progressive cavity) with variable-frequency drive speed control
Объёмные насосы работают на малых скорос: Positive-displacement pumps operate at low shear rates, maintain delivery at high viscosity, and transfer structured emulsions gently.
Высокооборотный центробежный насос на 29: A high-speed centrifugal pump at 2900 rpm throttled on the discharge
В вязком креме центробежный насос резко: In a viscous cream, a centrifugal pump sharply loses head and efficiency, while intense shear and recirculation in the volute destroy the lamellar network.
Любой водяной насос при условии увеличен: Any water pump provided the discharge port diameter is increased
Расширение напорного патрубка не устраня: Enlarging the discharge port does not eliminate internal viscous losses and high shear inside the centrifugal impeller.

Низкое абсолютное давление над зеркалом: Low absolute pressure above the liquid surface combined with the high vapor pressure of hot water starves the suction line of static head — the liquid flashes at the impeller eye.
Вакуум в питающем реакторе увеличит напо: Vacuum in the supply reactor will boost pump head and speed up discharge
Вакуум на стороне всасывания уменьшает,: Vacuum on the suction side reduces rather than increases the pressure pushing liquid into the pump.
Ничего не изменится, пока температура во: Nothing will change as long as the water temperature stays below 100 °C
Температура кипения зависит от абсолютно: Boiling point depends on absolute pressure: at 20 kPa, water already boils at 60 °C.
Готовую партию плотного крема на [[lgn|л: A finished batch of dense cream structured by a [[lgn|lamellar gel network]] must be pumped from the reactor to a filler hopper three meters up on the next floor. An available [[centrifugal-pump|centrifugal pump]] that reliably delivers 8 m³/h on water barely pushes a thin trickle of cream, its casing heats up, and the cream's viscosity at the filler drops by a third due to structural breakdown in the impeller clearance. Switching to a sanitary rotary-lobe [[pd-pump|positive-displacement pump]] with a variable-frequency drive solves both issues: flow becomes steady and texture is preserved.
Для переноса жидкости сеть требует преод: To move fluid, the piping system must overcome static elevation lift, the pressure difference between vessels, and friction losses $h_f(Q)$ in pipes, valves, and filters [@coulson1999]:
В турбулентном течении воды и тоников по: In turbulent flow of water and toners, friction losses scale roughly as $h_f \propto Q^2$. In [[laminar|laminar flow]] of viscous cosmetics, losses follow the [[hagen-poiseuille|Hagen–Poiseuille equation]] ($h_f \propto \mu Q / d^4$) or a power-law model for [[shear-thinning|shear-thinning]] fluids ($h_f \propto Q^n$ with $n < 1$) [@chhabra2008; @brummer2006].
**Рабочая точка** лежит на пересечении н: The **operating point** lies at the intersection of the pump head curve $H_{\text{pump}}(Q)$ and the system curve $H_{\text{sys}}(Q)$. A centrifugal pump's head drops with increasing [[flow-rate|flow rate]], and above a [[viscosity|viscosity]] of 100–300 mPa·s its head, capacity, and efficiency all plummet. In a positive-displacement pump, delivery is nearly proportional to rotor speed ($Q \approx q_0 N - Q_{\text{slip}}$) and depends only weakly on backpressure; therefore capacity is controlled via speed, and a relief valve must be fitted on the discharge to prevent deadheading against a closed valve.
Критическая проверка на стороне всасыван: The critical suction-side check is preventing [[cavitation|cavitation]] (flashing of liquid and vapor bubble formation when local pressure drops below vapor pressure $P_v$) [@coulson1999]. The available net positive suction head $\text{NPSH}_a$ must exceed the nameplate required $\text{NPSH}_r$ by a margin of at least 0.5–1.0 m:

Консерванты — в Приложении V, УФ-фильтры: Preservatives are in Annex V and UV filters are in Annex VI (and only substances on these positive lists may be used)
Верно: Приложения IV (красители), V (кон: Correct: Annexes IV (colorants), V (preservatives), and VI (UV filters) are closed positive lists with strict limits and conditions of use.
Оба класса ищут в Приложении II, где соб: Both classes are listed in Annex II, which compiles all permitted ingredients
Приложение II — это список запрещённых в: Annex II is the list of prohibited substances; if an ingredient appears there, its use in cosmetics is completely banned.

Компания выводит на рынок ЕАЭС два новых: A company is launching two new products in the EAEU market: a standard moisturizing hand cream and a children's SPF 50 sunscreen cream. Which conformity assessment documents are required under TR CU 009/2011?
Для крема для рук — декларация о соответ: An EAEU (EAC) declaration of conformity for the hand cream, and a State Registration Certificate (SGR) for the children's SPF cream
Точно: детская косметика и средства защи: Exactly: children's cosmetics and sun protection products are on the high-risk product list (Annex 12 of TR CU 009/2011) subject to mandatory state registration.
Для обоих продуктов достаточно внутренне: An internal laboratory certificate of analysis is sufficient for both products
Выпуск косметики в обращение на рынке ЕА: Placing cosmetics on the EAEU market is prohibited without an issued EAC declaration or SGR.
СГР оформляется только на импортные отду: An SGR is issued only for imported fragrances, whereas finished creams always require only a declaration
СГР оформляется именно на готовую космет: An SGR is specifically issued for finished cosmetic products in special categories (children's products, SPF, chemical peels, intimate hygiene, nanomaterials, etc.).
При выходном контроле партии крема вязко: During finished-product release testing of a cream batch, viscosity fell below the lower specification limit (OOS). How must the shift respond under ISO 22716 (GMP)?
Перевести партию в карантин, зафиксирова: Place the batch in quarantine, document the OOS result and deviation, investigate root causes, and complete disposition and CAPA before release
Верно: в системе GMP партию с результато: Correct: under GMP, an out-of-specification batch cannot be quietly reworked or shipped without a documented investigation and Quality approval.
Незаметно добавить загуститель в реактор: Quietly add thickener to the vessel and overwrite the number in the batch record
Любая незадокументированная корректировк: Any undocumented adjustment or falsification of records is a severe violation of data integrity and GMP.
Отгрузить партию, если запах и pH в норм: Release the batch as long as odor and pH are within specification
Несоответствие любому показателю специфи: Failure to meet any specification parameter (including viscosity) blocks batch release until a formal disposition is issued.
Для выпускника вуза слово «регуляторика»: To a recent graduate, “regulatory affairs” often sounds like legal paperwork far removed from the lab. In practice, however, a formula that fails restriction screening cannot be brought to market: you will have to reformulate, restart stability and challenge testing, and lose six months. Manufacturing is no different: a single missing signature in a batch record or an off-the-books salt addition can quarantine an entire metric ton of product. Knowing the map of core regulations and standards is essential from day one [@eu1223; @trts009; @iso22716].

Проследим, какие регуляторные и GMP-барь: Let's trace the regulatory and GMP gates a new product must pass:
1. **Проверка формулы (R&D):** по Прилож: 1. **Formula screening (R&D):** check UV filter limits under Annex VI of EU 1223/2009 (and equivalent annexes of TR CU 009/2011); check preservative limits under Annex V (e.g., phenoxyethanol $\le 1{,}0\ \%$); verify maximum fragrance level for a leave-on facial cream via the [[ifra|IFRA]] 51st Amendment certificate; and per EU 2023/1545 [@eu2023-1545] calculate allergen declarations above $0{,}001\ \%$ in INCI.
2. **Доказательная база:** проводим испы: 2. **Supporting evidence:** run stability and packaging compatibility studies per ISO/TR 18811 [@isotr18811] and preservative efficacy testing per ISO 11930 [@iso11930].
3. **Регистрация / досье:** для ЕС все д: 3. **Registration / dossier:** for the EU, all data (formula, CoA, microbiology, stability, exposure calculation) are compiled into **CPSR Part A**, after which a qualified safety assessor (toxicologist) signs **Part B**, and the dossier is maintained in the **PIF** by the Responsible Person. For the EAEU market, sunscreen falls under the TR CU 009/2011 special-category list — requiring an **SGR** (rather than a standard EAC declaration) [@trts009].
4. **Запуск серии по ISO 22716:** поступ: 4. **Batch launch under ISO 22716:** incoming raw materials are placed in [[quarantine|quarantine]] until passing [[incoming-control|incoming inspection]]; compounding follows the approved [[batch-record|Batch Record]] strictly. If QC detects an [[oos|OOS]] result (e.g., out-of-spec pH or microbiology), a [[deviation|deviation]] is logged, an investigation is conducted, and [[capa|CAPA]] actions are assigned [@iso22716].
1. **Считать, что раз ингредиент есть в: 1. **Assuming that because an ingredient appears in CosIng, it can go into any formula.** CosIng also lists prohibited Annex II substances—you must check its restriction status [@cosing].
2. **Проверять только декларацию EAC, за: 2. **Checking only EAC declarations and forgetting SGR.** Launching a children's cream, chemical peel, or SPF product under a standard declaration instead of an SGR directly violates TR CU 009/2011 [@trts009].
3. **Использовать одну и ту же отдушку в: 3. **Using the same fragrance in a hand cream and a lip balm without checking IFRA categories.** Limits for the “lip” category (potential oral exposure) are often many times stricter than for a rinse-off wash.
4. **Исправлять неудачную промышленную в: 4. **Correcting an off-spec production batch by eye without documentation.** Under ISO 22716, any departure from the approved procedure is logged as a deviation with Quality risk assessment; verbal agreements do not exist in GMP [@iso22716].

Строение рогового слоя по модели «кирпич: The “brick and mortar” structure of the stratum corneum, why skin needs pH 4.5–5.5, how humectants, emollients, and occlusives work biologically, and why harsh surfactants disrupt the barrier.
Учебный материал уровня 1; основан на об: Level 1 educational material; based on established principles of dermatocosmetology and cosmetic science references.

Наоборот, повреждение липидного барьера: On the contrary, lipid-barrier damage and keratin swelling accelerate transepidermal water loss (TEWL).

Воздействие ПАВ и pH сосредоточено прежд: The impact of surfactants and pH is concentrated primarily within the 10–20 µm-thick stratum corneum.
Потребитель наносит в сухом зимнем помещ: In a dry winter room (20 % relative humidity), a consumer applies an aqueous gel containing 8 % glycerin without any emollients or occlusives. What is most likely to happen to skin comfort and TEWL?
Без окклюзивного слоя хумектант не перек: Without an occlusive layer, the humectant cannot block evaporation into dry air, and on a compromised barrier it may even increase the sensation of dryness and moisture loss
Верно: глицерин удерживает воду в рогово: Correct: glycerin binds water within the stratum corneum, but to reliably reduce TEWL in dry climates it is paired with emollients and occlusives.
Глицерин создаст непроницаемую восковую: Glycerin will form an impermeable waxy film and reduce TEWL by 98 %
Физическую плёнку с таким снижением TEWL: A physical film achieving that level of TEWL reduction comes from hydrophobic occlusives like petrolatum, not water-soluble glycerin.
Вода из воздуха перестанет испаряться бл: Water from the air will stop evaporating due to a pH increase
Глицерин неионогенен, не меняет pH и не: Glycerin is nonionic, does not alter pH, and does not by itself block vapor diffusion into dry air.
Химик привык видеть в креме эмульсию в с: A chemist is used to seeing a cream as an emulsion in a beaker and a body wash as a micellar solution. Yet every formula is built to interact with living skin. Apply a wash high in sodium lauryl sulfate or a cream left at pH 8.2, and the test panel complains of tightness and flaking. Designing mild, effective products starts with understanding the upper skin barrier [@barel2009].

Главный защитный экран кожи — **[[stratu: The skin's primary protective shield is the **[[stratum-corneum|stratum corneum]]**, 10–20 µm thick. It is described by the **“brick and mortar”** model:
- **«Кирпичи» — корнеоциты:** плоские кл: - **“Bricks” — corneocytes:** flattened cells packed with keratin and natural moisturizing factor (NMF — amino acids, PCA, urea, lactates) that binds water.
- **«Раствор» — межклеточные липидные би: - **“Mortar” — intercellular lipid bilayers:** a lamellar phase of **ceramides, cholesterol, and free fatty acids** (~**50 : 25 : 15 %** by weight; barrier-repair formulas often target a ~**3 : 1 : 1** molar ratio) [@barel2009; @iwata2017].
Поверхность кожи покрыта **[[acid-mantle: The skin surface is coated by an **[[acid-mantle|acid mantle]]** with a physiological [[ph|pH]] of **4.5–5.5**. This acidic environment supports two systems:
1. **Ферментам сборки барьера:** **β-глю: 1. **Barrier-assembly enzymes:** **β-glucocerebrosidase** converts precursors into mature ceramides specifically at acidic pH; in alkaline conditions, bilayer assembly slows down [@barel2009; @buck2002].
2. **Микробиому:** кислый pH поддерживае: 2. **Microbiome:** acidic pH sustains commensal flora (`Staphylococcus epidermidis`) and suppresses pathogens (`Staphylococcus aureus`).
Целостность барьера измеряют по **[[tewl: Barrier integrity is measured via **[[tewl|TEWL]]** — transepidermal water loss in g/(m²·h). On healthy forearm skin, TEWL is $5\text{–}15$ g/(m²·h), rising to $30\text{–}60$ g/(m²·h) when lipid bilayers are disrupted. Cosmetics manage this process in three ways [@barel2009]:
| Класс | Биологическое действие | Влиян: | Class | Biological action | Effect on TEWL | INCI examples |
| [[humectant|Увлажнитель (хумектант)]]: | [[humectant|Humectant]] | Binds water in the stratum corneum, plasticizes keratin, replenishes NMF | Alone, does little to curb evaporation in dry air | `Glycerin`, `Sodium PCA`, `Urea`, `Panthenol` |
| [[emollient|Эмолент]] | Заполняет микр: | [[emollient|Emollient]] | Fills micro-fissures between corneocytes, partially replenishes lipids | Moderately reduces TEWL, improves suppleness | `Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride`, `Squalane`, `Ceramide NP` |
| [[occlusive|Окклюзив]] | Создаёт гидро: | [[occlusive|Occlusive]] | Forms a hydrophobic barrier on the skin surface | Sharply reduces TEWL (petrolatum up to 95–98 %) | `Petrolatum`, `Dimethicone`, `Butyrospermum Parkii Butter` |
**Почему жёсткие ПАВ повреждают барьер.*: **Why harsh surfactants damage the barrier.** Harsh [[anionic-surf|anionic surfactants]] with a high [[cmc|CMC]] (e.g., `Sodium Lauryl Sulfate`, SLS) carry a high concentration of free monomers. Monomers penetrate the stratum corneum, extract intercellular lipids, and bind to keratin, causing keratin swelling and NMF leaching [@rosen2012; @barel2009]. After washing, TEWL rises and the skin feels tight.
:::deep Разбор двух продуктов глазами би: :::deep Two Products Through the Lens of Barrier Biology
1. **Гель для умывания на 12 % SLS при p: 1. **Facial cleanser with 12 % SLS at pH 7.8:** free SLS monomers leach cholesterol and fatty acids and swell keratin, while pH 7.8 disrupts the acid mantle. Switching to a milder SLES + `Cocamidopropyl Betaine` blend lowers the CMC, enlarges mixed micelles, and cuts free monomer levels, while adjusting pH to $5{,}0\text{–}5{,}5$ protects β-glucocerebrosidase [@rosen2012].
2. **Барьерный крем для сухой кожи (pH 5: 2. **Barrier cream for dry skin (pH 5.0):** combines 5 % glycerin and 1 % `Sodium PCA` (water binding), 10 % squalane and triglycerides in a [[lgn|lamellar gel network]] (softening and structural mimicry of bilayers [@iwata2017]), and 3 % shea butter + 2 % dimethicone (semi-occlusion limits TEWL without a greasy film).
1. **Делать «увлажняющий» гель только из: 1. **Building a “moisturizing” gel solely from water and glycerin.** Without emollients and occlusives, it cannot reduce elevated TEWL in dry air.
2. **Игнорировать pH несмываемых кремов: 2. **Ignoring the pH of leave-on creams and cleansers.** An alkaline drift (pH 7.5–9.5) stresses the acid mantle and slows ceramide synthesis.
3. **Ждать восстановления барьера от «ма: 3. **Expecting barrier repair from a “claims-level” 0.001 % drop of ceramide.** Biological efficacy depends on meaningful levels and the balance of all three physiological lipids.
4. **Судить о мягкости геля по обильност: 4. **Judging cleanser mildness by lather volume.** Abundant foam often accompanies aggressive anionic surfactants with a high free-monomer fraction.
**Совет при чтении рецептур:** в занятии: **Tip for reading formulas:** in [“Reading an INCI List: Facial Cream”](#/labs/inci-sheet), group ingredients by their three barrier roles—humectant, emollient, occlusive—and check for protection against excess TEWL as well as a pH adjuster.

This bridge from general chemistry to the batch sheet rests on five core rules [@iupac-green; @barel2009].

1. **Молярная масса и [[stoichiometry|ст: 1. **Molar mass and [[stoichiometry|stoichiometry]].** Amount of substance $n$ relates sample mass $m$ and [[molar-mass|molar mass]] $M$ (g/mol): $n = m / M$. This governs every reaction: neutralizing 1 mol of triprotic citric acid ($\text{C}_6\text{H}_8\text{O}_7$) to citrate requires $3$ mol of $\text{NaOH}$, whereas 1 mol of lactic acid requires $1$ mol of $\text{NaOH}$ [@butler1998].
2. **[[mass-fraction|Массовая доля]] и [: 2. **[[mass-fraction|Mass fraction]] and [[molarity|molarity]].** Formulations use mass fraction $w = m_s / m_{\text{tot}}$, while buffer calculations use molar concentration $C = n / V$ (mol/L). Density $\rho$ (kg/L) links them via $C = 1000\,\rho\,w / M$ [@iupac-green].
3. **[[hydrate|Кристаллогидраты]].** Вод: 3. **[[hydrate|Crystal hydrates]].** Lattice water is part of the molar mass. When substituting a hydrate for an anhydrous salt, multiply the charge by $M_{\text{hyd}} / M_{\text{anh}}$ and subtract the water of crystallization from `Aqua`.
4. **Диссоциация солей и заряды ионов.**: 4. **Salt dissociation and ion charges.** [[electrolyte|Electrolytes]] yield different numbers of ions with different charges $z_i$: $\text{NaCl} \to \text{Na}^+ + \text{Cl}^-$ ($1{:}1$), $\text{CaCl}_2 \to \text{Ca}^{2+} + 2\text{Cl}^-$ ($1{:}2$), $\text{MgSO}_4 \to \text{Mg}^{2+} + \text{SO}_4^{2-}$ ($2{:}2$). Because [[ionic-strength|ionic strength]] $I = \frac{1}{2}\sum c_i z_i^2$ depends on the square of charge, divalent $\text{Ca}^{2+}$ and $\text{Mg}^{2+}$ affect carbomers and emulsions far more strongly than $\text{Na}^+$ [@butler1998].
5. **Пересчёт [[active-matter|активного: 5. **Converting [[active-matter|active matter]] by [[coa|CoA]].** The mass of commercial solution or paste is obtained by dividing by the actual active fraction:
